topics: Introduction to sustainable practices : Building life cycle
resource use in the built environment
construction ecology and principles of green engineering.
Codes related to green buildings: NBC, ECBC, ASHRAE, UPC, etc.
Energy Efficiency : Environmental impact of building constructions
operational energy and life cycle energy.
Methods to reduce operational energy : Energy efficient building envelopes
energy efficient and BEE rated appliances for heating and air-conditioning systems in buildings
Water conservation and efficiency : Rainwater harvesting methods for roof & non-roof
reducing landscape water demand by proper irrigation systems
Waste Management : Handling of construction & demolition waste materials
on-site and off-site organic waste management
Introduction to Green Buildings : Definition of green buildings
benefits of green buildings towards sustainable development.
Green building rating systems – GRIHA, IGBC and LEED
overview of the criteria as per these rating systems

partA.description: 2 Questions from each module.  Total of 8 Questions, each carrying 3 marks

partB.description: Each question carries 9 marks.  Two questions will be given from each module, out of which 1 question should be answered.  Each question can have a maximum of 3 sub divisions.

courseOutcomes.description: Understand the methodologies for sustainability and maintain indoor environmental quality
Describe energy efficiency methods used in green building practices.
Adopt various water efficiency criteria and waste management methods
Understand the principles and practices of green buildings
